datasets.foodloop_relevance: Directly evaluates fresh_produce surface decay on 3 major fruit types
datasets.limitations: Lacks vegetables (tomatoes, onions), leafy greens, bulk cafeteria trays, and low-light kitchen noise.

datasets.foodloop_relevance: Evaluates visible mold screening for bakery items
datasets.limitations: Severe sample size limitation (only 63 moldy images across entire dataset); class imbalance (78.5% healthy); restricted to Western sandwich bread slices; zero Indian breads or pastries.

cooked_meals_status.finding: No public or scientific RGB dataset exists for fresh vs. spoiled cooked meals. Microbial proliferation in prepared curries, rice, or stews does not yield reliable visible signatures during operational rescue windows (2-6 hours).

packaged_sealed_status.dataset_name: Packaged Food Hermetic Seal Integrity Dataset
packaged_sealed_status.finding: Standard RGB photos cannot evaluate contents inside opaque packaging or detect microscopic seal failures.
